what: When a photo enters at 10% from the bottom of the screen (90% from the top), it appears by settling from 1.05x and transparent to its normal size — size 1.2s · opacity .6s, both cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1), once only. A photo in the hero plays as soon as it loads.

options.hook: Screen height ratio (from top) counted as entered, default .9
options.[data-fx-part=media]: Inner photo that sinks (first child if none). The frame stays put while only the photo shrinks, cropped

from.where: index.css .hero__pic · shared.css .phero__pic (hero·subpage header photo) — when the original MainVisual has both -inview from ScrollMagic triggerHook .9 and the image-read flag (-imageloaded), transform 1.2s·opacity .6s
detail.html photo pile li — original .ef-io.tr-picture-in: when it enters IntersectionObserver rootMargin -30% 0px, the img goes from scale3d(1.1) · transparent → 1 · opaque, transition 2s ease-out

shared.js [data-inview-scale] (all photos, phone width only) — original scaleInViewAnimation: inner scale 1.125 → 1, 2s quart.out, plays once as soon as a single pixel enters the viewport, no opacity change
